/* menu-mapper.xml id="selectMenuList" 메뉴 목록 조회 */
WITH RECURSIVE menu_tree AS ( SELECT r.resource_id , r.prnt_resource_id , r.resource_name , r.resource_url , 1 AS lv , CAST(r.resource_name AS CHAR(1000)) AS menu_path , CAST(LPAD(r.sort_no, 5, '0') AS CHAR(1000)) AS sort_path FROM tbsy_resource r WHERE r.mb_id = #{mb_id} AND r.use_yn = 'Y' AND r.prnt_resource_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.resource_id , c.prnt_resource_id , c.resource_name , c.resource_url , p.lv + 1 , CONCAT(p.menu_path, ' > ', c.resource_name) , CONCAT(p.sort_path, '/', LPAD(c.sort_no, 5, '0')) FROM tbsy_resource c JOIN menu_tree p ON c.prnt_resource_id = p.resource_id WHERE c.mb_id = #{mb_id} AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.lv < 3 ) SELECT t.resource_id , IFNULL(t.prnt_resource_id, '') AS prnt_resource_id , t.resource_name , IFNULL(t.resource_url, 'NONE') AS resource_url , t.lv , CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbsy_resource s WHERE s.mb_id = #{mb_id} AND s.use_yn = 'Y' AND s.prnt_resource_id = t.resource_id) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isleaf , t.menu_path FROM menu_tree t ORDER BY t.sort_path
